when_used: Proprietors holding land in common apply for the land to be partitioned between them into separate parcels.

body_text.text: This Application is made by the above noted registered Proprietors of the land comprised in the above-mentioned Title.
The Proprietors HEREBY APPLY for the land to be partitioned in the following manner: ***

foot_notes: *Give details of all the proprietors : name; PIN; ID/Passport No.; and Address **Delete whichever is not applicable.
***The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”
**** Attach a Cadastral Map and a Cadastral Plan.

custom_fields.name: proprietors_details
custom_fields.label: Details of all the proprietors
custom_fields.prompt: For every registered proprietor: name, PIN, ID or Passport number and address, numbered 1, 2 and 3 as the form prints them

custom_fields.name: partition_schedule
custom_fields.label: How the land is to be partitioned
custom_fields.prompt: The parcels as they are to stand after the partition. One parcel per line, the cells separated by a pipe: cadastral plan number | parcel number | area (approximately) | proprietor
